cases.explain: «человеческому рассуждению» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

cases.explain: «открытая могила» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”

cases.explain: «Божьего страха» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”

cases.sentence: Ведь все согрешили, и все лишились ___, 24 и все получают оправдание даром, по благодати через искупление, совершенное Иисусом Христом.
cases.explain: «Божьей славы» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
